title: Stick Showdown
description: A high-noon stickman brawl on desert paper. Fight waves of bandits, scouts, slingers and brutes, then duel a bigger boss at the end of every level — from Cactus Jack to the burning El Sol. Five weapons unlock as you progress (fists, stick, machete, piercing spear, quaking sledge), every attack is telegraphed, and a perfectly timed dash empowers your next blow. Chain hits to raise your score multiplier, earn medals, and survive until high noon. Solo, touch-friendly, in English, French and Spanish.
controls: A/D or arrow keys to move, W / Up / Space to jump — or the on-screen pad on touch screens.
J or X to attack (chain presses for weapon combos), K or Shift to dash: you are briefly invulnerable.
Esc to pause. A raised weapon with a red ! means an attack is coming: dodge or dash through it.
credits: A game by Cédric Bernadac, created with AI agents (ZCode & Kimi K3.1 Pro).
